name: dog-pet-trot
note: PO 10-15 'Dog looks broken' (repeat of 10-14 'that dog looks strange'): the healthy pet dog (amb.dog, NpcView lod1 on every tier) trotting at the jog speed and fleeing at 4.8 m/s. The sim used to put a moving pet at the corgi's 0.3 m height while NpcView drew it at y - 0.7: the dog sank 40 cm (sinkMaxCm 40), only the paws showed as separate blobs and the buried legs' shadow smeared out from under the body. Gate: paws on the pavement (sink <= 1 cm), planted (slide <= 3 cm).
